status: Independent critique and proposed decisions, not a promoted new algorithm
decision_principle: Choose from a measured frontier of physical accuracy, wrong mass, useful coverage, signal fidelity, failure rate and cost, using only information available at inference

evidence_classes.source: Exact source inspection at the audited commit
evidence_classes.m2: Previously frozen M2 new-patient results, now inspected
evidence_classes.C01: Coherent omission of every odd major-grid row and column
evidence_classes.C02: Two disconnected visible regions of one planar sheet
evidence_classes.C03: Perfect points under progressively stronger finite homographies
evidence_classes.C04: Geometry-only comparison of triangle interpolation and homography fitted to the same exact correspondences
evidence_classes.CP: Predeclared 12-scene, 60-arm analytical development probe of global homography and shared residual composition, including negative results

decisions.choice: Keep original RGB, evidence and eligibility as separate outputs
decisions.reason: Missing grid does not imply missing visible text or waveform content
decisions.falsification: E07: no-grid header, margins, grid dropouts and opaque physical occlusions
decisions.acceptance: Original archive exactly matches input. Sampling source is original RGB. Grid confidence never directly zeros RGB. Hidden physical content is not claimed recovered.
decisions.limits: Archived original preservation does not prove that a resampled thin waveform retains its amplitude or contrast

decisions.choice: Use one identical cell complex for forward and inverse operations
decisions.reason: Independent triangulations can disagree even at shared observed cells
decisions.falsification: Shared edges, holes, conflicting cells and round-trip controls
decisions.acceptance: Forward/inverse use identical topology. Ambiguous overlap returns missing support. Bounds and orientation failures are explicit.
decisions.limits: Round-trip and orientation are implementation/topology checks, not physical error certificates

decisions.choice: Replace implicit fixed adjacent-major-grid identity with explicit pitch and skipped-line hypotheses
decisions.reason: Perfectly consistent IDs can be physically wrong when a regular subgrid is detected
decisions.falsification: E02: matched-density random dropout versus coherent 2x and 3x subgrids, major/minor ambiguity
decisions.acceptance: Recover scale with extra observable evidence or declare it ambiguous. Do not certify mm from a periodic point set alone.
decisions.limits: The C01 observed error is fault injection, not estimated detector failure frequency

decisions.choice: Retain multiple supported components and their registration ambiguity
decisions.reason: Discarding smaller islands loses correct local coordinate evidence
decisions.falsification: E03: visible islands with identifiable and unidentifiable relative offsets
decisions.acceptance: Keep local charts without fabricating an integer global offset. Count local coverage and global registration separately.
decisions.limits: More retained components do not by themselves imply a globally identifiable paper map

decisions.choice: Evaluate local orientation/spacing and multihypothesis lattice growth
decisions.reason: Exact projective observations already fragment the current graph under stronger perspective
decisions.falsification: E01/E04: perfect points first, network points second, increasing projective severity then nonrigid distortion
decisions.acceptance: Measure components, retained points, cycle conflicts, ID agreement, physical G/W/C/R and rejection separately.
decisions.limits: C03 native lattice rejection can still leave useful locally supported cells, so it is not a complete-RGB failure rate

decisions.choice: Include a fitted global homography and projective-plus-local residual as explicit challengers
decisions.reason: Perfect projective anchors do not make affine cell interiors projectively exact. Shared diagonals are C0, not generally C1.
decisions.falsification: E04b: flat homographies and genuine curved/creased controls with exact and noisy anchors
decisions.acceptance: A flat-projective case should not acquire measurable interior bias or artificial diagonal kinks when a simpler model is supported. Curved controls must remain capable of rejecting a global-only map.
decisions.limits: C04 is geometry-only with known IDs, not a native end-to-end or clinical comparison. Do not choose a branch using test gold.
decisions.candidate_composition: F(x)=T(H(x)), F^-1(u)=H^-1(T^-1(u)), with T sharing one cell complex from H(observed) to canonical coordinates
decisions.warning: Global H on a flat control is different from independent per-cell homographies. Numerical C0 continuity is not C1 continuity or physical accuracy. No image bank or RGB sampling was evaluated.
decisions.prototype_result_scope: Positive ideal/projective and curved controls, but W regressions on oblique creases and noisy/incorrect anchors. Not a promoted branch and not native competitor execution.

decisions.choice: Separate location noise, false points and wrong lattice IDs
decisions.reason: Fixed-ID denoising cannot repair systematic correspondence errors and can preserve the severe error tail
decisions.falsification: E06: hard anchors, soft anchors, explicit outliers and corrected/ambiguous ID hypotheses
decisions.acceptance: Attribute improvements through separate ablations. A corrected association must be assessed against physical truth rather than only a lower fitting residual.
decisions.limits: Preserving original observations for audit does not require imposing them as exact physical truth in every new candidate

decisions.choice: Keep the global curvature guard as a control and test region/edge-local regularization
decisions.reason: Global abstention avoids known crease damage but suppresses useful denoising elsewhere and preserves coherent errors
decisions.falsification: E05: no guard, global guard and localized guard with identical force/budget and both clean/noisy folds
decisions.acceptance: Improvement in activation or G must not conceal clean-fold W regressions, iteration limits or skipped difficult regions.
decisions.limits: The guard is a prior-conflict heuristic, not a true-crease certificate

decisions.choice: Retain support heuristics but calibrate their physical meaning separately
decisions.reason: Interpolated anchors and preserved local cells agree by construction even under coherent physical errors
decisions.falsification: Low-residual wrong-ID and scale-alias cases, followed by held-out physical risk/coverage evaluation
decisions.acceptance: Report G, W, C and R, raw finite maps and filtered maps. Any risk promise needs independent calibration units and explicit assumptions.
decisions.limits: Distance to nearby points, hull membership and Jacobian orientation do not establish mm accuracy

decisions.choice: Keep ranking scores distinct from calibrated localization uncertainty
decisions.reason: RANSAC/mesh fitting validates but does not weight scores. M2 rank weights are not probabilities or covariances.
decisions.falsification: E06: heteroscedastic and coherent localization noise, wrong high-score points and calibrated held-out residuals
decisions.acceptance: Any covariance or acceptance probability must be supported by calibration, including scale and viewpoint dependence.
decisions.limits: A score-weighted least-squares replacement is not automatically more physically accurate

decisions.choice: Separate full map proposal, actually resampled RGB and partial coordinates
decisions.reason: Output-canvas bounds can return original RGB even after a full map is proposed. A coordinate-only evaluator does not establish image delivery.
decisions.falsification: E07: output bounds, extreme scale, large margins and sparse support
decisions.acceptance: Count proposal accepted, RGB resampled, original fallback, local field available and no eligible coordinate as separate outcomes.
decisions.limits: Fallback original avoids damage but is not a successful global rectification

decisions.choice: Measure raster and signal fidelity after sampling
decisions.reason: A mathematically invertible coordinate map can still sub-sample thin traces or introduce geometric kinks
decisions.falsification: E07/E10: thin traces, extrema, no-grid header, varying output density and fixed downstream extractor
decisions.acceptance: Measure calibrated amplitude/time, sign, lead ownership and trace loss. Record native output and any common-density evaluation adapter separately.
decisions.limits: Do not freely fit away gain or time errors in scoring. No clinical benefit follows directly from a geometric proxy.

decisions.choice: Publish relative-gauge and autonomous-orientation endpoints separately
decisions.reason: Evaluation-only D4 signs/permutation and integer origin can remove errors that matter to time, amplitude and lead identity
decisions.falsification: E08: rotations, reflections, origin changes and known calibration
decisions.acceptance: Use exactly the same permitted gauge for all relative-geometry methods and separately score the uncorrected autonomous output.
decisions.limits: The existing gauge is scoring assistance, not gold supplied to inference, and must not be described as affine or scale rescue

decisions.choice: Separate native end-to-end, common-observation geometry and component substitution
decisions.reason: Feeding our anchors to an external interpolation recipe does not execute its native detector, preprocessing or calibrated pipeline
decisions.falsification: E09: verify weights, source pins, documented inputs, output units and native failure modes
decisions.acceptance: Label original implementation, adapted component, inspired reconstruction and unavailable proprietary product distinctly.
decisions.limits: A product without code/API access receives availability=unavailable, not a fabricated score or a zero-performance ranking

decisions.choice: Treat inspected M2 assessment as retrospective for M3 method design
decisions.reason: New decisions now use information learned from the prior assessment
decisions.falsification: E11: freeze wrappers/configurations before native comparator scores and use an untouched domain or group for confirmation
decisions.acceptance: Explicitly separate feasibility, retrospective comparison, selection and final confirmation. Record all patients and exclusions.
decisions.limits: Renaming an already-inspected split does not restore independence

decisions.choice: Add alternative geometry truth and external photographic data
decisions.reason: Patient separation does not remove shared generator, renderer or observation-model biases
decisions.falsification: E11: independent analytic maps, generator-family holdout and real captures with justified reference coordinates or paired signals
decisions.acceptance: State which endpoints have actual physical mm truth. Flat/photograph pairs or visual scores must not silently be treated as dense physical truth.
decisions.limits: A renderer self-consistency audit is useful but does not establish external physical calibration

decisions.choice: Use a Pareto decision and report all tails, not a single aggregate win
decisions.reason: A mean G gain can coexist with individual damage and an unchanged severe RMSE tail
decisions.falsification: Report case-level regressions, support-common and all-returned error, failure rates and scenario strata
decisions.acceptance: Prevent abstain-all from winning. State weights and intended utility before scores. Use descriptive small-sample uncertainty honestly.
decisions.limits: Pixel/query count is not the number of independent patients

decisions.choice: Choose per-image branches only from observable input evidence
decisions.reason: Picking the best method using the known rendering scenario or test error is not an autonomous algorithm
decisions.falsification: Freeze any router on development, then evaluate untouched cases without backend/scenario labels
decisions.acceptance: A best-of-methods oracle may be reported only as an upper bound, never mixed into deployed results.
decisions.limits: A homography is appropriate for a flat control but may be biased on a real crease. A single universal branch is not established.

decisions.choice: Profile and bound full pipeline resources, including masks and retries
decisions.reason: Hull products scale with query count times hull size and are repeated during eligibility. Geometry-only timings omit detector and RGB delivery.
decisions.falsification: Large frame, complex hull, output density sweep, budget exhaustion and warm/cold runs on named hardware
decisions.acceptance: Report stage timing, total wall time, peak memory, retries and output status. Precompute/reuse hull classifications where safe.
decisions.limits: The approximately 472 MB two-buffer estimate at 48x4096 queries and 100 hull edges is a static bound, not a measured peak

next_experiment_order: Freeze stage boundaries, method identities, exact source/weight pins, native domains and unavailable-access status
Run source-controlled analytical diagnostics C01-C04 and native feasibility without method selection
Compare native methods retrospectively on identical M2 cases with all failures retained
Run separate detector/organizer/geometry-only ablations to attribute differences
Use development to choose candidates and any input-only router
Freeze candidates and confirm on new uninspected groups and an external/alternative generator domain
prohibited_shortcuts: Declaring an adapted interpolation recipe to be the original commercial or published system
Using test gold or renderer backend/scenario to select the winning method per image
Counting original-preserved fallback as a successfully rectified full RGB output
Treating a low fitting residual, round-trip, positive Jacobian or high detector F1 as physical accuracy
Equating eight repeated views with eight independent patients
Claiming universal, clinical or state-of-the-art superiority from these structural controls
